start: Member app, Gym tab, a member whose gym plan covers today

user_sees: Title "Ask about your workout"
"Who should answer?" with "Any trainer or the owner" and the trainers
must_not: The row locked for a member with a running plan

steps.action: Type a question and press "Send question"
user_sees: "Sent. The reply will show on this page."
"Waiting for a reply. You can ask a new question once this one is answered."
"Your gym replied" with the answer

start: Member app, Message your gym page with both sides open

steps.action: Pick "A trainer" under "Who is it for?" and ask
user_sees: The question as a "Workout question" in the one list
must_not: The question sent to the gym's message list instead

start: Member app, a member whose plan ended yesterday

user_sees: ""Ask about your workout" is for members with a running plan." and "Renew my plan"

steps.action: An older app sends a question anyway
user_sees: "... Your question was not sent."

steps.action: With a running plan, ask a second question while one waits
user_sees: "You already have a question waiting. Wait for the reply, or take it back first."

start: Member app, a question waiting for a reply

user_sees: "You took this question back."
must_not: The trainer still asked to reply

user_sees: The new question waiting
must_not: A refusal because of the taken-back one

steps.action: Read the line under "Who should answer?"
user_sees: "Only the person you pick sees your question. "Any trainer or the owner" sends it to every trainer and the gym owner."
must_not: The desk reading a question to one trainer

start: Member app, Gym tab, a member who comes on a pass (FITPASS)

user_sees: ""Ask about your workout" is for members with a running plan."
must_not: A send box for a pass member

start: An older member app that still shows the send box to a pass member who also has an old gym plan running

user_sees: ""Ask about your workout" is for members with a running plan. Your question was not sent."
must_not: The question saved because the old plan is still running

start: A pass member who asked before the rule, with an old answered question

user_sees: "Your questions" with the old question and its reply

steps.action: The pass ends and the member buys a gym plan
user_sees: The send box opens
must_not: Still locked with a running gym plan and no pass

start: Admin app as the trainer, "Member questions", a question to this trainer

user_sees: "Waiting for your reply" with the question

steps.action: Type in "Your reply" and press "Send reply"
user_sees: "Sending…" then "Reply sent."

start: Admin app as the trainer, a new question

steps.action: Tap the bell line "{name} asked a workout question. Open Member questions to reply."
user_sees: Member questions opens
must_not: The old words "asked a trainer a question"

start: Admin app as the trainer, a question the member took back

user_sees: "The member took this question back."

steps.action: Press "Send reply" with an empty box
user_sees: A word to type a reply

start: Admin app as the trainer, a question with no reply for 14 days

user_sees: "Closed with no reply after 14 days." under "Answered and closed"

start: Admin app as a trainer, a question the member sent to another trainer

user_sees: Not listed, no alert
must_not: The question shown to a trainer it was not sent to

start: Admin app as the owner, "Member questions", a question to any trainer or the owner

user_sees: "Waiting for your reply" with the question

steps.action: Type in "Your reply" and press "Send reply"
user_sees: "Sending…" then "Reply sent."

start: Admin app as the owner, a new question

steps.action: Tap the bell line "{name} asked a workout question. Open Member questions to reply."
user_sees: Member questions opens
must_not: The old words "asked a trainer a question"

start: Admin app as the owner, a question the member took back

user_sees: "The member took this question back."

steps.action: Press "Send reply" with an empty box
user_sees: A word to type a reply

start: Admin app as the owner, a question with no reply for 14 days

user_sees: "Closed with no reply after 14 days." under "Answered and closed"

start: Admin app signed in with the gym's owner key (no owner on the staff list)

user_sees: The member reads "Your gym replied"
must_not: The owner's full name to the member
